summary: Frontend-only testing of new Footer + placeholder Policy pages. All required scope validated: Footer renders on home, /collections, /archives, /journal, /contact and product page with emblem, wordmark, tagline, and copyright '© 2026 HoneyGold Drip™. All rights reserved.'. All 6 quick links + 4 customer care links resolve to correct hrefs. All 4 policy pages render with correct title, placeholder note ('not been published yet'), and working Contact link to /contact. Invalid slug /policies/unknown redirects to /. Social placeholders (Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok) are SPAN elements (not anchors, no href) with 'Official channels — coming soon' text. Mobile 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow on / or /collections. Regression: 7 product cards visible, Size Guide button opens/closes, Add to Cart increments cart badge to 1.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx and Policy.jsx are clean, small, use react-router Link (no full page reloads), and follow data-testid conventions. No issues found.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer + Policy placeholder pages fully working. Note: product Add-to-Cart testid is 'pdp-add-to-cart' (not 'add-to-cart-button' as review spec suggested); cart badge in Navigation shows count correctly. All 7 collection products render.
